description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uduwawala, Harispathuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320319 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels of land in various locations. It contains detailed information about land parcels, owners, extents, encumbrances, and legal status - all falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
